answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 4 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the sonnet release is logged with every signature, the whisper audit reveals the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, since each signer must be independent on the pearl graph and each risks its bond. That is 27 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
